translations.translation: In every sea that has a quick movement, its root is from the expanse of the deep; A drowned person asks the swimmer, 'How did you reach there?'
His poetry resonated in that strange, grand domain; He wanted to chant, and all his songs were like a steel fist that struck the heads of the ignoble.
When the day increased, it brought the burden of loneliness upon my shoulders; The tired history marches forward on an unknown path, and we are the words of the poet.
A crowd of spectators, who seek nothing but stables and feeding troughs in their own stalls; How far we are from understanding his words!
In the time of the learned, by following the annotators and the archaeologists of other countries, we are engaged in 'discussion' and 'research' in the realm of...
We find the meaning of the words of Masnavi and Divan Shams to be perfect rhyme, surplus, deficiency, and elision; and we, in the name of intellectuals, are satisfied with this.
We see that Professor Arberry has called him the most poetic of poets, along with another compatriot of his.
But now, neither those learned people who deem us incapable of realizing our own 'essence' nor we, who have given them their due, can...

This time, in the sea of Jalaluddin Muhammad's poetry, we have found someone to listen to; let us bravely set aside those historical and literary ailments and confusions that, according to today's critics, are...
His poetry is not as transparent as a crystal goblet.
It is a creation, and now with the complex system of existence and language...
